title: Specify task-sync delta wiring, cursor provenance and receipt-first replay
outcome: Prepare the concrete integration and format decision for proportional ordinary export/import, Model A, and exact zero-payload replay.
acceptance: Specify how ordinary export, commit import and Model A consume the same changed set, use explicit bootstrap or rebuild, apply changed tasks atomically, and preserve historical exact receipts before any payload read.

Resolve the project.json feed-cut provenance and existing ordered documents_fingerprint versus incrementally maintained inventory_root without silently changing stored fingerprint meanings or guessing missing historical cursors.

For every proposed durable change, name exact tables, record types and fields, conversion or retirement counts, ID/link preservation, import/repair behavior, no-write refusal and every-live-store cutover requirement; present the plan through Fable for Greg before coding.

Define end-to-end 2,000-task/history tests for five changed, one added and one deleted task, both directions, no-op and replay after later local edits, with payload read/decode/write/removal and graph-closure counters. No implementation or store mutation occurs in this design item.

completion.summary: Delivered source-backed additive delta/cursor/receipt-first design; Codex16737 reviewed, all four Medium and adopted Low corrections incorporated and presented through Fable before implementation. No source/store mutation or execution credit.
